extraction.name: SCIENCE QA
extraction.description: A new benchmark that consists of 21k multimodal multiple choice questions with diverse science topics and annotations of their answers with corresponding lectures and explanations.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.publisher: 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Questions in the SCIENCE QA dataset are sourced from open resources managed by IXL Learning. To construct SCIENCE QA, the original science problems were downloaded and then individual components (e.g. questions, hints, images, options, answers, lectures, and solutions) were extracted from them based on heuristic rules.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open resources managed by IXL Learning, an online learning platform curated by experts in the field of K-12 education.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Invalid questions were manually removed, such as questions that have only one choice, questions that contain faulty data, and questions that are duplicated. If there were multiple correct answers that applied, only one correct answer was kept. The answer options of each question were shuffled to ensure the choices do not follow any specific pattern. Semi-automated scripts were then used to reformat the lectures and solutions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For language models, the newline separators (\n) in the text are replaced with \\n when encoding the inputs. Captions were extracted from a captioning model based on ViT and GPT-2 for the images to serve as visual context. For questions without any context, the context text is replaced with an empty string.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A data exploration tool was developed to review examples in the collected dataset, and incorrect annotations were further manually revised by experts.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Any antisocial data points will be removed from the dataset based on feedback.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset does not contain any user usage data or personally sensitive information such as gender and race.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: SCIENCE QA provides a useful benchmark for multi-modal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and general artificial intelligence. It will contribute to the development of K-12 education applications such as tutoring systems.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: After careful examination of the dataset, no improper content, such as pornographic information, racial remarks, or harmful social bias was found.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Validation, Testing. Used as a benchmark for multi-modal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and general artificial intelligence, as well as for developing K-12 education applications.
